notice: General educational morphology descriptions only. NOT verified findings in any displayed tile.

attributes.ADI: Large clear lipid spaces with thin cytoplasmic rims; peripheral nuclei may be visible.
attributes.BACK: Little or no tissue; may contain blank slide background or staining artifacts.
attributes.DEB: Fragmented cellular or extracellular material without organized intact tissue architecture.
attributes.LYM: Dense collections of small round cells with dark nuclei and relatively little cytoplasm.
attributes.MUC: Pale extracellular mucin or mucus pools with sparse cellular structure.
attributes.MUS: Bundles of elongated eosinophilic spindle-shaped smooth-muscle cells.
attributes.NORM: Relatively regular colonic gland/crypt architecture with organized epithelium.
attributes.STR: Connective-tissue matrix with stromal cells and variable collagenous background.
attributes.TUM: Abnormal epithelial glandular architecture; may include crowded, irregular glands and cytologic atypia.
